text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Satsuki Sho—the first race of the Classics—arrives, but Narita Brian feels some dissatisfaction at only being able to race against runners in the same year as her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At that moment, Hishi Amazon steps up to challenge her, having already claimed the first tiara of the Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Listening to Hishi Amazon, Narita Brian realizes the significance of being able to participate in once-in-a-lifetime races. She prepares herself mentally for the experience.
